title: Support Inseego pro x 5g
body:
This device is running a qualcom snapdragon chipset. It is the device distributed by Calyx to their users. Calyx has expressed interest in having rayhunter support as a feature for their subscribers. 
Some nice features of this device:
* global band support
* built in GPS 
* audio alerting 

We were able to root this device by sending 130 '0's to the usb interface to enable ADB mode. ADB gives a root shell by default. 

This device uses the new userspace diag port /dev/ffs-diag so we will have to figure out how to support that.
